subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Localized and biochemically recurrent prostate cancer

steps.tx: Nonmetastatic disease is stratified into **low, intermediate, high and very-high risk**. Low risk means organ-confined disease with PSA below 10 ng/mL and grade group 1. High risk includes extraprostatic extension, PSA above 20 ng/mL, or grade group 4 to 5. Very-high risk adds seminal vesicle T3b invasion, adjacent-organ T4 invasion, or multiple high-grade biopsy cores.
steps.say: Nonmetastatic disease is stratified into low, intermediate, high and very-high risk. Low risk means organ-confined disease with PSA below 10 nanograms per millilitre and grade group 1. High risk includes extraprostatic extension, PSA above 20, or grade group 4 to 5. Very-high risk adds seminal vesicle T3b invasion, adjacent-organ T4 invasion, or multiple high-grade biopsy cores.

steps.tx: Multiparametric MRI graded by **PI-RADS** is usually done before biopsy. PI-RADS 1 and 2 lesions can safely avoid biopsy, while PI-RADS 3 to 5 lesions receive targeted biopsy. This reduces detection of indolent grade group 1 tumours without missing clinically relevant cancers. PSA itself is prostate specific, not cancer specific, so prostatitis and BPH can also raise it.

This reduces detection of indolent grade group 1 tumours without missing clinically relevant cancers. steps.tx: For **low-risk** disease, **active surveillance** is preferred, with repeat biopsy reserved for discordance between imaging and biomarkers. For intermediate and high-risk disease, **radical prostatectomy** or radiotherapy is offered, with radiotherapy often combined with androgen deprivation for longer durations in high-risk patients. The ProtecT trial showed no 10-year survival disadvantage for active surveillance.

right.title: Radical treatment
points: High risk: ADT up to three years with radiotherapy

steps.tx: After radical prostatectomy, PSA should become **undetectable within about 6 weeks**. Persistent measurable PSA suggests residual or recurrent disease. In recurrence, PSMA PET helps localise disease, but it cannot detect low-volume microscopic spread, so a negative scan does not exclude nodal involvement. Serial PSA monitoring follows the patient after treatment.
